item.name: The Slasher
item.mainLimit: Needs clean timing before survivors reach safer routes
item.cardSummary: The Slasher is the baseline killer for learning ambushes, chases, and pallet pressure. He fits players who want a direct kit before saving Screws for a specialized unlock.

item.name: The Stalker
item.power: Stalk, Evil's Grasp, and Hunt Mode
item.mainStrength: Undetectable setup into a timed chase burst
item.mainLimit: Weak value if the stalk window is wasted or survivors stay alert
item.cardSummary: The Stalker starts quiet, builds pressure by watching survivors, then cashes that setup into Hunt Mode. He rewards patience before the chase becomes loud.
item.baseSpeed: 110% (18.7 studs/sec) in Stalker Mode; 120% (20.4 studs/sec) in Hunt Mode
item.intentRadius: 0 in Stalker Mode; 90 in Hunt Mode

item.name: The Hidden
item.mainStrength: Leap pressure around pallets, vaults, and walls
item.mainLimit: Mark is narrow and misses can leave painful endlag
item.cardSummary: The Hidden is for players who like quick routes and precise commitments. Leap helps cut through obstacles, while Mark rewards accurate reads more than panic swings.

item.name: The Killer
item.mainStrength: Punishes grouped survivors with chained hits
item.mainLimit: Whiffs, stuns, and split teams break the chain value
item.cardSummary: The Killer turns crowded routes into danger. Frenzy lets him vault and chain hits, so he is strongest when survivors cluster or hesitate in a chase path.
item.baseSpeed: 115% (19.6 studs/sec); Frenzy speeds up with chained hits

item.name: The Masked
item.mainStrength: Unpredictable speed, stealth, lunge, vault, or one-shot windows
item.mainLimit: Random masks make planning less consistent
item.cardSummary: The Masked changes the round through temporary masks. He suits players who can adapt quickly when a mask gives speed, stealth, longer lunges, faster vaults, or a one-shot threat.
item.intentRadius: 90 studs; Richter mask removes the radius

item.name: The Abysswalker
item.mainStrength: Multi-survivor pressure, slows, and map-wide disruption
item.mainLimit: Dark Severance can be crouch-dodged by prepared survivors
item.cardSummary: The Abysswalker is a control pick for players who want more than basic chase swings. His slash and burst can pressure objectives, loops, and grouped survivors.

item.name: The Veil
item.power: Pierced Vow and Through the Veil
item.mainStrength: Ranged zoning, wall shots, and generator-side pressure
item.mainLimit: Missed spears and cluttered cover reduce pressure fast
item.cardSummary: The Veil rewards aim and map reads. Spears let him zone routes, threaten straight-line movement, and punish predictable survivors through walls when the angle is right.

item.name: The Cure
item.power: Elucidation and I Am The Cure
item.mainStrength: Pestilence, spike pressure, and SCP-049-2 minions can snowball
item.mainLimit: Needs setup and can lose value if survivors avoid clouds and manage spikes
item.cardSummary: The Cure is the expensive control killer built around infection and minions. He fits players who want to spread pressure over time instead of winning every chase with one clean hit.
